description: This file contains unit tests for the SessionData-related components in the OpenClaw project, verifying behavior of session kind detection, token formatting, usage percentage clamps, and session row flag labels.

classes.name: SessionDataTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for session data components in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: session kind from key detects common kinds
methods.description: Tests the detection of session kind categories from string keys.

methods.name: session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected
methods.description: Verifies that token counts are correctly formatted into human-readable strings.

methods.name: session token stats percent used clamps to100
methods.description: Checks that the usage percentage does not exceed 100%.

methods.name: session row flag labels include non default flags
methods.description: Ensures that session row flag labels include all relevant non-default flags.
